keywords: Election petition challenging election of the 4th and 5th Respondents as Members of Parliament for Galle District; preliminary objection on maintainability upheld; Petitioner’s averments fell under Section 92(1) (electoral district) rather than the mandatory grounds under Section 92(2) (candidate election) of the Parliamentary Elections Act. Held - Application dismissed without costs for failing to plead grounds under Section 92(2).
legistation: Parliamentary Elections Act No. 1 of 1981 (as amended)
